simple.meaning: חָזֵק (châzêq) is a Hebrew object word meaning “powerful.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 19:19. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָזֵק (H2390) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: חָזֵק (châzêq) / H2390 is traced through Exodus 19:19, 2 Samuel 3:1 with generated occurrence evidence.
